headline: Margins expand on cost cuts; impairment drives GAAP loss
summary_short: Bruker's Q3 revenue of $874.0M rose 1.6% y/y (0.7% organic) and non-GAAP EPS of $0.56 rose 24%. A $174.5M goodwill impairment pushed GAAP EPS to a $0.81 loss.
summary_long: Non-GAAP operating margin widened 4.0 points to 16.3%, which management attributes to cost discipline and execution. BSI revenue rose 0.8% (organic -0.4%) and BEST revenue rose 11.2%. BSI book-to-bill exceeded one for the fifth straight quarter. Management reconfirmed FY26 organic growth of 1–2% and non-GAAP EPS of $2.10–2.15, updating reported revenue guidance to $3.52–3.56B for currency.
confidence_notes: GAAP results include non-cash goodwill impairment charges of $174.5M. Non-GAAP figures are company-defined. Non-GAAP EPS growth is as stated in the release.

drivers.explanation: CEO attributes the very significant margin expansion and non-GAAP EPS growth to a focus on cost discipline and execution.
Third quarter GAAP results include non-cash goodwill impairment charges of $174.5 million.
Growth came from acquisitions (1.7%) and 0.7% organic growth, with currency translation an unfavorable 0.8%.
